packageRules.description: Electron and the two tools that build against it move together: electron-vite and electron-builder each track Electron's majors, and a bump to one of the three without the others is a build that fails in a way nobody can read. One pull request, and the packaging jobs on all three platforms judge it.

TypeScript is held below 8 until somebody has actually read that release: every `pnpm typecheck` in this repo and the diagnostics the Files view shows an Employee come from this compiler, so a major here is a day's work and not a dependency bump.
